source: Nexus NCS export (challenge shiny + itempool_*_shiny + Cosmetics_Weapon_Shiny_*)
proof_rule: Challenge_Shiny_* / challengereward_*_shiny_* for slug, OR itempool_*_shiny with legendary/pearl-legendary comp + Cosmetics_Weapon_Shiny_*
refresh_command: node scripts/build-pearl-phosphene-flags.mjs && node scripts/build-community-pearlescent.mjs && node scripts/build-loot-reference-data.mjs && node scripts/sync-skin-labels-from-pearl-flags.mjs
notes: Pearlescent rarity is NOT automatically a Shine The Brightest phosphene.
can_be_phosphene=true requires export challenge and/or shiny itempool+cosmetic proof.
|"c",1| pearl camo and bare Cosmetics_Weapon_Shiny_* names are not proof.
Crow-Sourced (Order AR, crowsourced) is not Midnight Defiance (Vladof CrowdSourced).
Manual export-adjacent overrides applied after Nexus derivation.
Crow-Sourced Order AR must never inherit Vladof CrowdSourced / Midnight Defiance challenge proof.
